story: No function under src/ above complexity 25 unless frozen in scripts/complexity-baseline.json, and a frozen one may only come down.

story: As the founder, I want any commit that changes a locked screen to carry a Founder-Approved line, so that finished designs never change without my yes.

O1 -> "passes a branch that touches nothing locked",
"fails a commit that changes a locked file without the trailer",
"passes the same change with the trailer",
"an empty trailer value is no approval",
"the trailer must be a trailer, not a sentence in the body"

"checks each commit on its own: one approved, one not",
"ignores commits that are on the base already",
"reports an uncommitted locked change without failing on it",
"refuses to run against a base it cannot see"

"matches exact paths and trees, never tests",
"names only files and directories that exist (a rename must update the list)"
O4 -> "locks %s, which CLAUDE.md names" (one per locked screen file)

story: scripts/local_ci.sh runs every command the CI unit job runs, plus `npm run build`, on the Node version CI and .nvmrc name.
proves:
found the job -> "found the job and its steps"
mirrored      -> "runs `%s`" (one per unit-job command)
build         -> "runs the production build"
node          -> "stops below the job's node-version, which .nvmrc names too"

O2  When a newer version exists, the save is reported as out of date and
not sent again.
O3  A moved document also counts as out of date; any other refusal is an
error.
proves:
O1 -> "PUTs the whole document with the version it was edited from"
O2 -> "reports a supersede instead of RETRYING it over the new version"
O3 -> "supersedes on a document-moved refusal and fails the save on any other"
why: The old retry re-sent pre-Take words over the text a just-landed Take built (Never-rule 5).

story: As a reader of the journal, I want links in posts limited to safe web addresses, so that a post can never run a script on me.
outcomes:
O1  javascript:, data:, vbscript:, protocol-relative //host and ftp links
are refused.
O2  https and http links and site paths are accepted, so images and files
in a post still show.
proves:
O1 -> "rejects script schemes and protocol-relative URLs"
O2 -> "accepts web addresses and site paths"

story: As a speaker tapping "More about self-modeling theory", I want a missing or empty post to show nothing rather than a broken screen.
outcomes:
O1  A post that is not found, has no title, or can't be reached offline
gives nothing to show.
proves: O1 -> "is null for anything but a post with a title and words: no broken screen"

story: As a speaker, I want my recording uploaded with its slides and project, a slow server treated as still processing, a payment problem not called a failed analysis, and a discarded Take never re-sent, so that I never lose or duplicate a Take.
outcomes:
O1  The upload carries my slides, the deck and when I moved to each slide.
O2  The upload names only the project and its one upload key.
O3  A server timeout on a stored recording shows as "still processing".
O4  A payment problem says the recording is safe, not that analysis failed.
O5  A Take I discard while it uploads is reported as discarded and is not
re-sent another way.
proves:
O1 -> "appends slides + presentation_ref + slide_advances when a deck is attached"
O2 -> "sends only the canonical project id and upload key"
O3 -> "routes a 504 with session_id into the async 'processing' path"
O4 -> "keeps 402 out of the analysis-failed path"
O5 -> "reports `discarded`, never the connection-error copy",
"does NOT re-send the discarded take down the BFF lane"
why: Never-rule 3: never break record -> process -> Ideal Text.

story: As the founder, I want a record that a speaker saw feedback counted as saved only when every part of it was accepted, so that the learning record never claims a speaker saw something they didn't.
outcomes: O1  If any one receipt is refused, the whole save reports "not saved".
proves: O1 -> "returns false when any surface receipt is not accepted"

story: As a speaker, I want agreeing to training use refused clearly while pooled training is switched off, so that I never think I agreed to something that isn't running.
outcomes:
O1  While pooled training is off, the agreement is refused with the
server's own explanation.
proves: O1 -> "keeps consent writes fail-closed when Phase 2 is disabled"

story: As the founder, I want "a moment was opened or skipped" recorded without ever breaking the screen, so that we learn what speakers see while they are never blocked.
outcomes:
O1  An event the server already had is told apart from a failure.
O2  A switched-off route or no connection is a quiet failure, never a
crash.
proves: O1, O2 -> "tells an already recorded event from a failure, and never throws"

story: As a speaker, I want the helper words I chose to stay after I edit my Ideal Text, until I pick new ones, so that my chosen phrase isn't lost.
outcomes:
O1  After my edit, each paragraph still carries its chosen helper words
and where they sit, and they are still highlighted.
O2  A paragraph with no chosen helper words gets none.
proves: O1, O2 -> "merges the snapshot's root phrase, span and iteration by part id"
why: Never-rule 5: helper words stay until the speaker picks new ones (audit B3).

story: As a speaker, I want locking a paragraph to send the words I was looking at, and to tell "decide the pending suggestions first" apart from "your text is out of date", so that locking works even on a text I never edited and I get the right message.
outcomes:
O1  Locking sends the lock together with the words on my screen.
O2  "Decide pending suggestions first" and "out of date" come back as two
different answers.
proves:
O1 -> "PUTs the lock with the words the student was looking at"
O2 -> "discriminates UNDECIDED from STALE on the same 409"

story: As a speaker, I want my slides to stay intact whether or not I have edited my Ideal Text, and the app to refuse to guess when I added or removed paragraphs, so that a paragraph never lands on the wrong slide and the deck never collapses into one block.
outcomes:
O1  No edit yet (owner_edit {text: null, parts: []}): the core read keeps
the server's Paragraph -> Slide mapping and the server's part ids.
O2  An edit with the same paragraph count: each slide keeps its paragraph,
now under the edit's part id, so the zip matches the parts served.
O3  An edit that added or removed a paragraph: no mapping is guessed
(pieces is null, the deck shows unlinked).
proves:
O1 -> "keeps the server's slide mapping when there is no edit yet"
O2 -> "re-keys each slide's paragraph to the edit's part id"
O3 -> "refuses to guess when a paragraph was added or removed"
why: Production 2026-09-19: an empty owner edit was read as an edit (a truthiness check) and the deck lost its slides.

story: As a speaker buying a plan, I want checkout to open with the right plan and return pages, and a clear message when plans are unavailable, so that paying either works or tells me why not.
outcomes:
O1  Choosing a plan sends that plan with the success and cancel pages and
opens checkout.
O2  Plans switched off or misconfigured say "Plans aren't available right
now."; other refusals show the server's message; an answer without a
checkout link is an error.
proves:
O1 -> "posts the tier with both return URLs and opens the checkout"
O2 -> "tells the refusals apart"
why: Payments are on the critical path.

story: As a speaker, I want a practice check to reach my screen only as "praise or try again, and which cue", never the machine's number, so that I never see a score.
outcomes:
O1  The result passed on holds only what to do next and which cue, and
nothing else.
proves: O1 -> "keeps only next and key from a praise check"
why: Never-rule 1: no scores or numbers shown to speakers.

story: As the founder, I want the phone's wait after Stop reported in the background and never awaited, so that timing telemetry never slows or breaks practice.
outcomes:
O1  A failed upload sends no timing report.
O2  A successful upload resolves with the practice while its timing report
is still in flight, and the report names that attempt and both clocks.
O3  A failing report neither throws nor rejects: it returns nothing to wait on.
proves:
O1 -> "a failed upload reports nothing"
O2 -> "a successful upload answers without waiting on its report"
O3 -> "a failing report changes nothing"
why: V4 B1.4 (founder O5): the wait from Stop is measured, never awaited.

story: As a guest uploading my slides, I want my guest identity sent with the deck, so that my deck isn't refused before I record.
outcomes: O1  A guest's deck upload carries the guest identity and no login.
proves: O1 -> "sends a guest's owner token"
why: Every guest deck was refused before the parser ran (2026-10-08).

story: As a speaker, I want to agree to exactly the terms the server stored, and be told plainly when there is nothing to agree to or I'm blocked, so that my consent is real and I'm never stuck in a loop.
outcomes:
O1  Terms waiting for my agreement are shown with their countries and
minimum age.
O2  No active terms means "unavailable", not "please agree".
O3  A blocked person is told they are blocked, not asked to agree again.
O4  My agreement sends back the four fingerprints of the texts exactly as
received, and never the texts themselves.
O5  A guest identity that is refused is replaced once; refused again, the
app stops rather than going on.
proves:
O1 -> "maps an active policy awaiting acceptance"
O2 -> "an inactive policy is unavailable, NOT acceptance_required"
O3 -> "a blocked principal is blocked, NOT acceptance_required (PLF-T1)"
O4 -> "sends back the four hashes EXACTLY as received",
"never sends any policy COPY back to the server"
O5 -> "a refused guest identity is forgotten and minted again once; refused again, the read fails closed"
why: Consent is on the critical path: a receipt must prove the person agreed to exactly the stored copy.

story: As a speaker, I want deleting a project to send one request with a one-time key, and to change nothing when refused, offline or signed out, so that deletion is safe and can be repeated.
outcomes:
O1  Asking to delete a project sends one request with a one-time key and
shows the pending deletion.
O2  A refusal or no connection changes nothing; signed out, nothing is
sent at all.
proves:
O1 -> "asks with an idempotency key and reads the open request"
O2 -> "changes nothing when refused, offline or signed out"
why: Deletion is on the critical path.

story: As a guest who later signs up, I want my projects kept under a guest key and moved to my account, with the key forgotten only after the move, so that I never lose my work.
outcomes:
O1  The guest key the server issues is kept and sent with my later
requests.
O2  Signing up moves my projects using both my login and the guest key,
and the guest key is forgotten after the move succeeds.
proves:
O1 -> "stores the issued guest credential and reuses it as an owner header"
O2 -> "clears the guest credential only after an authenticated atomic claim"

story: As the founder, I want the "this Take is getting long" warning threshold to come only from the server, so that I can change it without a deploy and the app never invents one.
outcomes:
O1  A missing or unusable threshold gives no threshold, never a made-up
default.
proves: O1 -> "never substitutes a default when the field is missing or unusable"

story: As a speaker, I want recording progress shown only when the server gives a real threshold and total, so that I never see a made-up progress figure.
outcomes:
O1  A missing, zero or null threshold or total gives null (nothing shown).
O2  A real total and threshold map through, with the server's unlock flag
or, when it is missing, unlocked once the total reaches the threshold.
proves:
O1 -> "returns null on a missing / non-positive threshold or missing total"
O2 -> "maps the server's total and threshold"
why: C-2 / S2: the total is the backend's; the browser never sums it.

story: As a speaker finishing the Feedback walk, I want the closing summary to show exactly the words the server saved, and to be skipped when there is nothing to say, so that I never see invented or empty text.
outcomes:
O1  The summary shows the words of the message the server stored.
O2  If the server fails or stores only blank text, there is no summary.
proves:
O1 -> "are the stored Lounge row's body, as the backend answers"
O2 -> "are none when the backend fails or stores nothing to say"
why: Locked Feedback walk (lock 2026-10-12, sections 2.7 and 3).

story: As a speaker, I want feature rollout read from the server and treated as "off" when it can't be read, so that a hiccup never switches on unfinished features.
outcomes:
O1  A readable answer maps the features the server turned on.
O2  A 401, a 5xx or a thrown fetch is the empty state (nothing on), never
an error.
O3  The rings are read once per page load: every later caller shares it.
proves:
O1 -> "maps the features the server turned on"
O2 -> "a 401, a 5xx or a thrown fetch is the empty state, never an error"
O3 -> "reads once per page load"

story: As a speaker, I want "send to my coach" to target exactly this project and Take, so that my coach reviews the right recording.
outcomes:
O1  The request names this project and this Take exactly, and comes back
as sent.
proves: O1 -> "sends exact encoded Project and Take coordinates"

story: As a coach, I want the receipt that my card was shown recorded honestly, and a refusal reported as a refusal, so that blind review stays provable.
outcomes:
O1  A receipt the server refuses comes back as not saved, never faked as
saved.
proves: O1 -> "a refused receipt is refused, never faked"
why: Never-rule 2: coach judgements stay blind.

story: As a coach, I want saving my judgement to bring back "what happened" in that moment when the server sends it, and never on a refused save, so that I see the moment's read only after my own answer is in.
outcomes:
O1  A 200 carrying moment_read hands the read back mapped.
O2  A 200 without it leaves it out (the caller reads it the old way).
O3  A refused save (400) gives only the error, never a read.
proves:
O1 -> "a saved judgement carries the moment's read back"
O2 -> "a saved judgement without a read leaves it out"
O3 -> "a refused save never carries a read"
why: C2 (founder 2026-10-08); Never-2: coach judgements stay blind.

story: As the founder, I want it impossible to build a confidence label the rater never gave, so that training data never holds made-up answers.
outcomes: O1  No answer, an empty answer or an unknown answer builds nothing to send.
proves: O1 -> "REFUSES to build a body without a real answer — a null that slipped through would fabricate a call the rater never made"
why: A fabricated training row can't be told from a real one afterwards.

story: As a speaker, I want a Take that can't be deleted because it is part of my history to explain why in approved words, so that I understand and my history stays whole.
outcomes:
O1  A refused Take deletion shows the approved line about the project's
history.
proves: O1 -> "maps a refused take to the approved take line"
why: Never-rule 5: every old version stays in the history.

story: As a guest, I want my feedback on suggestions saved under my guest identity, so that my choices count before I sign up.
outcomes: O1  My feedback on a suggestion is sent with my guest identity.
proves: O1 -> "forwards the signed Guest ID for a pre-signup feedback decision"

story: As a speaker, I want my answer about a feedback item saved against the exact feedback I saw, and a changed answer accepted with its follow-up, so that my judgements are recorded correctly.
outcomes:
O1  My answer is saved against that feedback item only, with no recording
details added by the app.
O2  A changed answer is accepted as a save, with what to show next.
proves:
O1 -> "writes the frozen feedback identity without a caller-controlled clip"
O2 -> "reads the 200 revised body as a save, with its follow-up"

story: As a speaker, I want the price list to show at once from my last visit, change only when it really changes, survive a short outage and disappear when pricing is turned off, so that prices are fast and never wrong.
outcomes:
O1  The last price list shows straight away on my next visit, and an
unchanged answer from the server changes nothing on screen.
O2  A new price list from the server replaces the shown one and is kept
for next time.
O3  A lost connection keeps the shown list; pricing turned off removes it.
O4  A damaged saved copy is never shown.
proves:
O1 -> "is kept from a live read and served first on the next open, then confirmed behind it"
O2 -> "replaces the shown list when the backend publishes a new one"
O3 -> "keeps the shown list through a blip, and drops it when pricing is turned off"
O4 -> "never serves a copy the parser rejects"

story: As a speaker, I want my balance read once per page and re-read after I spend, so that the number I see is never from before a purchase.
outcomes:
O1  Wallets reading at the same time share one balance request.
O2  A spend anywhere in the app (the tokens-spent window event) drops the
shared read: the wallet asks the server again and shows the new number.
O3  An unreadable balance is not shared: the next wallet asks again.
proves:
O1 -> "serves every wallet from one request"
O2 -> "a spend makes the wallet read the balance again"
O3 -> "does not share an unreadable balance: the next wallet asks again"
why: Founder 2026-10-16: one balance request per open, not one per wallet.

story: As a speaker, I want a failed balance check shown as "unknown" (not zero), "out of tokens" to keep its renewal date and leave recording on, and no price shown when the charge state is unknown, so that I'm never wrongly blocked or charged.
outcomes:
O1  A missing or broken answer means tokens are off, never on.
O2  A balance the server couldn't read is "unknown", not zero.
O3  "Out of tokens" keeps the renewal date.
O4  No price label is shown when it isn't known whether I was charged.
proves:
O1 -> "treats a missing or malformed envelope as off, never as enabled"
O2 -> "reads available:false as UNKNOWN, never as zero"
O3 -> "reports can_record:false as EXHAUSTED, keeping the renewal date"
O4 -> "shows nothing when the charge state is unknown, never assuming unpaid"
why: Never-rule 3: a bad balance read must never hide the record button.

story: As a speaker, I want a training-consent change that fails to say why, so that my screen never shows a choice that did not save (consent).
outcomes:
O1  Offline: the save is refused with NETWORK.
O2  A server refusal comes back with the server's own code (e.g. a stale
copy of the sentence), never as a saved state.
O3  A refusal without a readable code becomes HTTP_<status>.
O4  A saved change returns the state now in force.
proves:
O1 -> "maps a thrown fetch to NETWORK"
O2 -> "passes the server's refusal code through"
O3 -> "falls back to HTTP_<status> when the refusal has no code"
O4 -> "returns the state now in force when the save went through"

story: As a speaker, I want my training-consent choice read once per page with my login, and read again after I change it, so that every screen shows my current choice.
outcomes:
O1  All screens on a page share one read, sent with my login.
O2  After I change my choice, the next read shows the new choice.
proves:
O1 -> "serves every reader from one request, sent with the bearer"
O2 -> "reads afresh after a write"

story: As a coach labelling clips, I want never to see the machine's rating or score, so that my judgement stays blind.
outcomes:
O1  The clips I label carry no machine rating or score, even if the
server sent one.
proves: O1 -> "never surfaces a band or machine read even if one were served (N1)"
why: Never-rule 2: no coach sees the machine's guess before answering.

story: Concurrent profile reads share one request, and a failed read is not shared, so page load does not hammer the backend and one blip does not stick.
outcomes:
Each caller fetching its own profile; or a failed (null) read being
served to every later caller for the rest of the window.
proves:
one request -> "serves every caller from one request"
no failure  -> "does not share a failed read: the next caller asks again"
why: If removed: A change to the shared read could multiply profile requests per page, or pin a signed-in coach to "no profile" after one error.

story: As a speaker, I want my saved moments grouped by project in the server's order, and a failed load not shown as "no moments yet", so that my album is accurate.
outcomes:
O1  Moments stay grouped by project, in the order the server gave.
O2  A failed load is reported as a failure, not as an empty album.
proves:
O1 -> "keeps the backend's project grouping and per-project order"
O2 -> "returns null on a failed read, never an empty album"

story: As a speaker, I want my practice answer saved against the exact recording I heard, unchanged, so that my judgement is credited to the right moment.
outcomes:
O1  The save names the project, Take and moment I heard, and my answer as
I gave it.
proves: O1 -> "sends the exact recording and the answer unchanged"

story: As a coach, I want the review context to stay hidden until the server unlocks it, even after I've labelled everything, so that my judgement stays blind.
outcomes:
O1  Without the server's unlock, context stays hidden even when all my
blind labels are done.
proves: O1 -> "keeps context locked when the server sends no gate (audit B4)"
why: Never-rule 2: coach judgements stay blind.
